evidence.title: Disney Planning TV Restructuring as Streamlining Continues

occurrences.checkable_against: Horacio Gutierrez memo to Disney legal and global affairs staff
occurrences.quote_span: In a memo to staff, Disney chief legal and global affairs officer Horacio Gutierrez said his team “will be a much smaller organization than it is today,” citing advances in automation.
occurrences.speaker: Horacio Gutierrez
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney television reorganization staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: The reorganization is expected to affect some of the executives who run those units, the people familiar with the matter said.
occurrences.speaker: people familiar with the matter
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney Entertainment Television organizational structure records
occurrences.quote_span: They include ABC Entertainment, 20th Television, Hulu Originals, Disney Kids & Family, National Geographic Content and Freeform.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney television reorganization planning documents
occurrences.quote_span: A primary goal for the TV reorganization is to structure the business in a way that makes sense for streaming customers, rather than around brands created decades ago for linear television, one of the knowledgeable people said.
occurrences.speaker: one of the knowledgeable people
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Dana Walden remarks at Bloomberg conference on October 1, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: She said “there is a need to constantly evaluate how you’re structured” and “how big is the organization.”
occurrences.speaker: Dana Walden
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney early-retirement acceptance records and television planning timeline
occurrences.quote_span: The company waited to see how many took the offer before moving forward with its TV plans, some of the people familiar with the matter said.
occurrences.speaker: some of the people familiar with the matter
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney television restructuring plan approval records

occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney legal and global affairs unit staffing and restructuring records
occurrences.quote_span: Cuts are also in the works at Disney’s legal and global affairs unit, which has about 1,000 employees.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Disney corporate restructuring plans and internal workforce records
occurrences.quote_span: Disney DIS -3.40%decrease; down pointing triangle is planning a restructuring of its television operation that’s expected to result in hundreds of layoffs and the consolidation of divisions, according to people familiar with the matter.
occurrences.speaker: people familiar with the matter
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring

occurrences.checkable_against: Dana Walden remarks at Bloomberg conference on October 1, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Disney President and Chief Creative Officer Dana Walden, speaking at a Bloomberg conference Thursday, said the company is taking a bunch of divisions that have been run separately and “centralizing as a television business, not a bunch of silos.”
occurrences.speaker: Dana Walden
occurrences.subject: Disney television operation restructuring
